specialties.name: General Physician
specialties.description: Your first stop for fevers, infections, routine checkups and ongoing health concerns. Our general physicians take time to understand your history and refer you onward only when it's genuinely needed.

specialties.name: Dermatology
specialties.description: Diagnosis and treatment for acne, eczema, psoriasis, hair loss and other skin, hair and nail conditions, along with cosmetic dermatology consultations.

specialties.name: Dental Care
specialties.description: Routine cleanings, cavity fillings, root canals, extractions and cosmetic dentistry, delivered with modern pain-management techniques.

specialties.name: Pediatric Care
specialties.description: Growth tracking, vaccinations and treatment for common childhood illnesses, in a clinic built to put younger patients at ease.

specialties.name: Diabetology
specialties.description: Blood sugar management plans, HbA1c monitoring and lifestyle guidance for patients living with type 1 or type 2 diabetes.

specialties.name: Physiotherapy & Rehabilitation
specialties.summary: Movement recovery after injury or surgery.
specialties.description: Hands-on rehabilitation for sports injuries, post-surgical recovery, chronic pain and mobility loss, with individually tailored exercise plans.

specialties.name: Psychology / Therapy
specialties.description: One-on-one counselling for anxiety, stress, relationship difficulties and other mental health concerns, in a private and judgement-free setting.

specialties.name: General Allergy Clinic
specialties.description: Allergy testing and long-term management plans for seasonal, food and skin allergies, including immunotherapy options.

doctors.name: Dr. Anjali Mehta
doctors.about: Dr. Mehta has spent over a decade treating everyday illness and chronic conditions, with a focus on preventive care and clear communication with patients.

doctors.name: Dr. Rohan Kapoor
doctors.about: Dr. Kapoor treats acne, eczema and hair loss, and also consults on cosmetic dermatology procedures.

doctors.name: Dr. Sneha Iyer
doctors.about: Dr. Iyer specialises in painless dental procedures, from routine cleanings to root canals and extractions.

doctors.name: Dr. Arvind Rao
doctors.about: Dr. Rao has cared for children for 15 years, with particular focus on early growth tracking and vaccination schedules.

doctors.name: Dr. Priya Nair
doctors.about: Dr. Nair helps patients manage type 1 and type 2 diabetes with personalised diet, medication and monitoring plans.

doctors.name: Dr. Karan Malhotra
doctors.about: Dr. Malhotra works with athletes and post-surgical patients on structured recovery and mobility programmes.

doctors.name: Dr. Fatima Shaikh
doctors.about: Dr. Shaikh provides confidential one-on-one counselling for anxiety, stress and relationship concerns.
